body:
## Your brand, our production

Starting a clothing brand is easier when the production partner understands both design and the market. We help new and growing brands with ready designs, custom development and full production in our Jaipur unit.

## What private label includes

- **Your neck label and wash-care label**
- **Your hang tags and packaging**
- Production of **our designs** or **your own designs / tech packs**
- Print, colour and fabric changes on request
- Photos and videos before dispatch

## Good for

- Instagram and website brands
- Marketplace sellers building their own brand
- Boutiques that want an exclusive label
- International brands sourcing from India

## Steps

1. Share your idea, reference designs and target price
2. Choose fabric, print and sizes
3. Sample development and approval
4. Advance payment and production
5. Quality check and dispatch

[WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) or fill the [wholesale enquiry form](/wholesale/#enquiry).

faq.q: Can I start with a small quantity?
faq.a: Yes, small brands are welcome. The minimum depends on whether you choose our existing designs or custom development.

faq.q: Will you put my brand name on the product?
faq.a: Yes. We attach your neck labels, tags and packaging. You can send them to us or we can arrange them for you.
